description: Partial PACE Integrated Mapping session ending at upstream's IM stub abort; **upstream behavior only**, hence runners:["swift"]. MSE:Set AT + GA1 (nonce) hit the chip; upstream's doPACEStep2IM then throws PACEError(Step2IM, IM not yet implemented), leaving the chip mid-protocol with no GA termination (upstream terminate-chaining is dead code). The DO80 nonce ciphertext is illustrative: the stub throws before it is used. The Dart port implements IM: see pace_session_im_ecdh_aes128.json / pace_session_im_dh_aes128.json. MSE:Set AT is upstream's form, without DO84.
